<TD WIDTH="9%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>Item&#8201;5.02</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B>Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers;
Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>Election of Directors </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On October&nbsp;20, 2026, the following persons were elected as directors of MSGS Spinco, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) effective
immediately following the time of the distribution by Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. (&#8220;MSG Sports&#8221;) to its stockholders of all of the issued and outstanding shares of Company&#8217;s common stock as set forth in Information Statement
(the &#8220;Information Statement&#8221;), dated October&nbsp;9, 2026, filed as Exhibit 99.1 to the Company&#8217;s Current Report on Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">8-K</FONT> filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the
&#8220;SEC&#8221;) on October&nbsp;9, 2026: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Designated as directors elected by the holders of the Company&#8217;s Class&nbsp;A Common

<TD WIDTH="9%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>Item&#8201;5.03</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B>Amendments to Articles of Incorporation or Bylaws; Change in Fiscal Year. </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On October&nbsp;20, 2026, the Company filed with the Nevada Secretary of State its Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation (the
&#8220;A&amp;R Articles&#8221;), which authorized 165,000,000 shares for issuance, 120,000,000 shares of which are designated as Class&nbsp;A Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share, 30,000,000 of which are designated as Class&nbsp;B Common Stock,
par value $0.01&nbsp;per&nbsp;share, and 15,000,000 of which are designated as preferred stock, par value $0.01&nbsp;per share. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The above
description is qualified in its entirety by reference to the A&amp;R Articles, which are attached as Exhibit 3.1 to this Current Report on Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">8-K</FONT> and incorporated into this Item 5.03 by reference. </P>
